blocks.content: Provide relief and compensation for environmental damage.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Ensures the speedy and effective delivery of environmental justice.
Provides financial relief and compensation for environmental damage.
Promotes sustainable development while safeguarding ecological balance.
Protects biodiversity and enforces statutory environmental laws effectively.

blocks.content: • Provide relief and compensation for environmental damage.

items: NGT is specifically tasked with providing relief and compensation for environmental damages.
Speedy disposal of environmental cases and enforcement of laws are core objectives tested in exams.
Balancing development with biodiversity protection is a statutory mandate of the tribunal.
